title: Black Oodie/Blanket/Gown $1 (500 Each Available, Sign up Now for 4 Nov 7pm AEDT Start, 1 Per Customer) + $9.99 Delivery @ Oodie
body:
Deal: Black Oodie/Blanket/Gown $1 (500 Each Available, Sign up Now for 4 Nov 7pm AEDT Start, 1 Per Customer) + $9.99 Delivery @ Oodie

[Nzgm] I imagine they'll all be gone in 3 seconds
[BestTechAdvisor] All the vibe coders will be creating scripts to 'drop catch' them.
Oodies are just plastic bags anyway.
[Slo20] They did the deal last year and that was pretty much the outcome.
[gilbarc] Lol I tried this last time around, they were gone in seconds. Not worth the effort
[breadylonglegs] theres a good chance they'll just take your information for marketing purposes and you wont get any benefit if they sell out in seconds
thats why they ask for your information first for a chance to win the opportunity to buy one
[Lucille Bluth] They also share your mobile and email address with third parties
Personal information: The Promoter may collect personal information in order to conduct the Promotion and/or for other purposes as notified by the Promoter and may, for this purpose, collect, use and disclose such information to third parties, including but not limited to agents, contractors, service providers, suppliers and, as required, regulatory authorities. Participation in the Promotion is conditional on providing this information.
[pavman] Been reported in a number of news channels too 7 news / 9 news etc.. as above, not worth the effort
[Tommohalby] Do not try. Not worth effort and it took me 2 years to get off their mailing list 🤣 4 different times I was told I was purged from their system and there was no chance of getting contact from them. Total muppets 🙃
[mrhugo] Just harvesting info under the cloak (I mean Oodie) of a competition.
Can we tag this as unobtainable or a competition, because IMO it reads more like a game of chance/comp and not a bargain.
[michael9865] Opening in a new tab, knowing i will probably forget and never look at it amongst the hundreds of other tab i have open for the same reason
[Frunk] For all the upvotes, I am adding a downvote based on the comments here that this is effectively a data harvesting campaign.
